fields.Name: T088 - Credential Categories Hierarchical Tree
fields.Description: Recursive parent/child tree built client-side (buildTree) with expand/collapse-all and per-node detail — not a flat grid; no other area renders a self-built hierarchy tree.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and choose 'Credentials', then open the 'Categories' section. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Verify a hierarchical category tree renders with indentation for nested categories (or a valid empty state). Use the 'Expand' and 'Collapse' buttons in the top-right (and/or per-node chevrons) and confirm the visible tree depth changes. Then click a category node to open its detail panel showing subcategory and credential-type counts.

judgeValidationCriteria: A nested/indented category tree renders OR a valid empty state is shown
Expand/Collapse controls change the visible tree depth
Selecting a category node opens a detail panel with counts (Credential Types / Subcategories)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
